covered_report_window.after_close: Friday, November 13, 2026 after the U.S. market close
covered_report_window.before_open: Monday, November 16, 2026 before the U.S. market open

methodology.disparity_definition: 0-100 composite dispersion of direction scores, reversal-risk values, and call-category agreement across Pass A, B, and C; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: No new method change. Existing key-metric-first, priced-in penalty, low-bar reversal-risk floor, and timing-confirmation rules applied.

market_context_summary: October PPI rose 0.3% month over month and 6.5% year over year, sustaining rate and input-cost pressure; the S&P 500 and Nasdaq were lower intraday while China property and consumption remained uneven.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic revenue and adjusted operating-margin conversion
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: High valuation; World Cup benefit rolls off
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Raised organic-growth expectations and broad contract momentum favor an upside reaction if margins convert, though valuation limits conviction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS about $0.75 and revenue about $5.29B; options sources indicate roughly a 7% event move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Organic growth and margin conversion finish above the raised framework with a constructive FY2027 outlook.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: One-off sports volume masks weaker base growth or wage inflation restrains margins.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Event move estimate about 7%; stock trades at a premium earnings multiple.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Company raised FY2026 organic revenue-growth expectations after Q3; independent public revision detail is limited.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Q4 delivery guide versus vehicle-margin durability
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Mix pressure; high-margin service revenue normalizes
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record deliveries and a de-risked share price support upside, but the reaction hinges on whether volume converts into vehicle margin and credible Q4 guidance.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q3 revenue consensus is near RMB23B; gross-margin expectations center around the high teens.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Q4 delivery guidance validates October's record and vehicle margin holds near or above 12%.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Price mix and service-revenue normalization drive a margin miss despite strong units.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options sources indicate an event move near 8%; shares were down sharply over six months.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Several brokers reduced targets in late October on expected margin compression despite record deliveries.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Contribution-margin durability amid weak housing GTV
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: China property slowdown overwhelms efficiency gains
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Broad contribution-margin gains create a modest positive edge, but China housing demand keeps reversal risk above the allocation ceiling.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The market expects efficiency gains to offset soft housing transactions; detailed public Q3 consensus is sparse.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Gross margin stays near the improved Q2 level while rental profitability and existing-home share hold.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: GTV and revenue contraction deepen enough to swamp cost control.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: One public options source indicated an event move near 8%.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public revision evidence is limited; Q2 margin performance exceeded expectations in third-party research.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: AI investment depresses profit; ads remain weak
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI cloud can offset legacy ad pressure enough for a modest upside reaction, but investment intensity and search weakness make the setup fragile.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus revenue is about RMB30.6B and EPS about RMB6.16; public previews expect cloud strength but weaker profit.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: GPU-cloud growth reaccelerates and operating cash flow remains positive with ad declines stabilizing.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Online marketing deteriorates and AI capex or opex drives another earnings miss.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply roughly 8%, slightly above the stock's longer-run earnings move.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent public research raised revenue but cut operating-profit assumptions, reflecting mixed revisions.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Raised revenue guide and peak-season upside
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Weak same-hotel RevPAR and a favorable share setup create downside risk if peak-season pricing disappoints, but raised guidance keeps reversal risk material.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Investors expect peak-season strength after management raised full-year revenue growth guidance to 4%-8%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: China RevPAR reaccelerates and international weakness proves temporary.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Occupancy and pricing remain soft while the stock already discounts a clean recovery.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public options data was insufficient; preview commentary described shares near highs.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Management raised revenue guidance in Q2; current sell-side revision breadth was not reliably available.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: FY2027 beef-loss outlook versus chicken strength
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Low bar; chicken and Prepared Foods relief
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Severe beef-cycle losses and weaker foodservice demand lean negative, but two guidance cuts have lowered the bar enough to make relief upside plausible.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $0.65 on roughly $14B revenue; the whisper is higher near $0.71.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: FY2027 beef losses improve faster than feared while chicken and Prepared Foods stay strong.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Beef losses remain elevated and the new FY2027 outlook resets earnings lower.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 6%, below the stock's long-run average earnings move.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The 30-day EPS consensus was stable after Tyson's September preannouncement.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Membership revenue and path back to breakeven
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Very low bar; short-form/AI relief squeeze
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Falling membership revenue and downward estimate revisions support downside, but the depressed price and low expectations make an upside squeeze highly plausible.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus points to a small loss and about $909M revenue; EPS expectations were cut materially over the prior month.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Content performance, short-form share, and cost control restore break-even visibility.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Membership and advertising weaken again while losses persist.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were down about 6.6% intraday and post-earnings drift since Q2 was sharply negative.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public estimate data showed broad downward revisions for Q4 and FY2026.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Revenue execution remains weak despite better gross margin, but a 47% post-Q2 decline and strategic EaaS narrative make the bearish call vulnerable.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus revenue is roughly $32M and EPS about -$0.04; Q2 revenue was only $20.35M.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Backlog converts, 20% gross margin proves durable, and GeoPura supports a credible growth path.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Order conversion slips again and cash burn remains elevated.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 13%; short interest near 7% with roughly eight days to cover raises squeeze risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public estimates remain sparse and inconsistent; evidence quality is only medium.
